spans.s:
किट r. 1st cl. (केटति)
 1. To go or approach.
 2. To alarm or terrify.
 3. To
dread, to fear.

किट्ट n. (-ट्टं) Excrement, excretion, dirt.
 E. किट् to go, here implying to
go out of, (the body, &c.) and क्त aff.

कीट r. 11th cl. (कीटयति)
 1. To tinge or colour.
 2. To bind.

कीट m. (-टः) A worm, an insect.
 E. कीट् to colour or dye, क aff.

किटि m. (-टिः) A hog.
 E. किट् to go, and कि affix; also किटि.

किटिभ m. (-भः) A bug.
 E. किटि a hog, भ who resembles, from भा to
shine, affix ड.

किट्टवर्जित n. (-तं) Semen virile.
 E. किट्ट dirt, &c. वर्जित deprived.

किट्टाल m. (-लः)
 1. A copper vessel.
 2. Scoria, rust of iron, &c.
 E. किट्ट
dirt, अल् to be able, अच् aff.

कीटक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Harsh, hard, unfeeling.
 m. (-कः)
 1. A worm, an
insect.
 2. A bird, panegyrist, descended from a Kṣatriya father
and Vaiśya mother.
 E. कीट a worm, and कन् aff.

कीटघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Sulphur.
 E. कीट a worm, and घ्न what destroys.

कीटज n. (-जं) Silk.
 f. (-जा) Lac, an animal dye of a red colour.
 E. कीट a
worm, and ज born.

कीटपक्षोद्भव m. (-वः) The change from the chrysalis or larva to the but-
terfly.
 E. कीट, पक्ष a wing, and उद्भव evolution.
